args.query: Effect-TS: decode input with Schema, typed tagged errors, and provide a service via Layer

results.title: Effect 4 Schema classes, typed errors and retries, tested with @effect/vitest
results.summary: Effect 4 Schema.Class models with checks, brands, FiniteFromString and fromJsonString for decode and encode, TaggedError failures, and Effect.retry with exponential backoff verified on the TestClock using @effect/vitest.

results.title: io-ts codec decode and encode
results.summary: Define io-ts runtime codecs for an object, optional fields, unions, arrays and a branded type, then decode unknown input, report errors with PathReporter and encode back to plain JSON offline.

results.title: ts-morph code generation and AST codemods in memory
results.summary: Generate a typed TypeScript client module with ts-morph structures, type-check it with pre-emit diagnostics, and run codemods (cross-file rename, var to const, strip console.log) on an in-memory file system.

results.title: msgspec Structs to JSON Schema with constraints and tagged unions
results.summary: Generate JSON Schema from msgspec Structs using Annotated Meta constraints, tagged unions and optional fields, then decode payloads with the same validation rules.

results.title: deepmerge-ts nested object and array merge
results.summary: Deep-merge nested objects and concatenate arrays with deepmerge-ts while leaving sources untouched.

results.title: ts-pattern exhaustive matching on discriminated unions
results.summary: Match TypeScript discriminated unions exhaustively with ts-pattern match, P selectors and .exhaustive(), covering nested event handling without unsafe defaults.

results.title: http-errors with Express error middleware
results.summary: Express routes that throw http-errors and reject asynchronously, mapped by a central middleware to RFC 7807 problem details with expose-aware messages and a 500 fallback, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: AJV 8 JSON Schema validation with ajv-formats
results.summary: Compile JSON Schema drafts with AJV 8, enable email/uri/uuid formats via ajv-formats, and return field errors from validate.errors for API payloads.

results.title: Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema with json-schema-to-typescript
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas into TypeScript interfaces with json-schema-to-typescript, covering required and optional fields, enums, $ref definitions, descriptions as JSDoc and strict additionalProperties.

results.title: GraphQL schema mocking with @graphql-tools/schema and @graphql-tools/mock
results.summary: Build an executable schema with makeExecutableSchema and layer deterministic mocks, a MockStore, MockList and partial real resolvers on top with addMocksToSchema, including mutations that write to the store.
